biometricdisabled: Done: you will sign in with your PIN.
biometricenabled: Done: next time you can use your fingerprint or face.

confirmdeleteaccount: Are you sure you want to remove {{fullname}}'s account on {{sitename}} from this phone?

reconnectpassword: Or sign in with your password
sitecheckfailed: Could not check your organisation: check your connection and try again.
sitenotallowed: This app is for the organisations whose platform Oksigenia hosts, and this one is not among them. Open it in your browser.
switchaccount: This link signs in {{name}} at {{site}}. Is that you?
